Based on the image provided, here is the specific location and description of the visible text:

**Location:**
The text is located on **four small, white rectangular cards** (price tags or labels) placed in front of the pastries inside the glass display case. There is one card for each type of pastry group:
1.  In front of the pink macarons (far left).
2.  In front of the long chocolate-topped eclairs/pastries (center-left).
3.  In front of the fruit tarts with raspberries (center-right).
4.  In front of the cream-topped tarts (far right).

**What it appears to say:**
The text is **illegible** due to the resolution and angle of the photograph. While you can clearly see that there are lines of text printed on these cards (likely listing the name of the item, ingredients, and price), the specific words are too blurry to be read.

**Prominence:**
The text is **tiny and incidental**. The cards are small relative to the food items, and they serve a functional purpose rather than being a decorative or main focal point of the image. They blend into the background of the display case.
